description: Edit a member's nickname or voice state. Voice changes (server mute, server deafen, move to another voice channel) only apply while the member is connected to voice. Role changes go through assign_role and remove_role. Moving someone into a voice channel they cannot join themselves lets them hear it, and lifting a server mute or deafen undoes what a moderator did, so those need confirming: the first call changes nothing and returns a preview and a confirm_token, and repeating the call with the token makes the change. Everything else, muting and deafening included, happens at once.

confirm_token.description: The token from this exact action's preview. Where the app can show a confirmation dialog, calling with it asks the user there, and it happens only if they agree.

guild.description: Guild (server) name or ID. Omit to use the default guild.

move_to_voice.description: Voice channel name or ID to move the member into.

nickname.description: New nickname, or empty string to clear it.
